```{r}
# 3-letter → 1-letter amino-acid code map
aa3to1 <- c(
  Ala="A", Arg="R", Asn="N", Asp="D",
  Cys="C", Gln="Q", Glu="E", Gly="G",
  His="H", Ile="I", Leu="L", Lys="K",
  Met="M", Phe="F", Pro="P", Ser="S",
  Thr="T", Trp="W", Tyr="Y", Val="V"
)

convert_to_G4R <- function(x) {
  # extract 3-letter → position → 3-letter
  m <- regmatches(x, regexec("p\\.([A-Za-z]{3})([0-9]+)([A-Za-z]{3})", x))[[1]]
  ref  <- aa3to1[m[2]]
  pos  <- m[3]
  alt  <- aa3to1[m[4]]
  paste0(ref, pos, alt)
}

card11_exp$variant_pro <- sapply(card11_exp$`aa change`, convert_to_G4R)

card11_exp <- card11_exp %>% dplyr::select(variant_pro, log2_score)

card11_exp <- card11_exp %>%
  group_by(variant_pro) %>%
  summarise(log2_score = mean(log2_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

card11_exp <- na.omit(card11_exp)
card11_exp <- card11_exp %>%
  filter(!grepl("NA", variant_pro))
card11_exp #2395
```

```{r}
plotting_data <- card11_df %>%
  drop_na(log2_score, ESM.1v) 

# Calculate the Two Residuals (Kept from your original code) ---
# Signal: What part of ESM1v is NOT Stability?
model_signal <- loess(ESM.1v ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")
plotting_data$Signal_Residual <- residuals(model_signal)

# Exp residual: What part of SGE is NOT stability?
model_exp <- loess(log2_score ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")
plotting_data$Exp_Residual <- residuals(model_exp)

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
# --- Calculate Statistics for the Text ---
# Correlation
spearman_val <- cor(plotting_data$Signal_Residual, plotting_data$Exp_Residual, 
                    method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

# Linear Model P-value (To support "significant positive slope")
lm_model <- lm(Exp_Residual ~ Signal_Residual, data = plotting_data)
lm_summary <- summary(lm_model)
p_value <- lm_summary$coefficients[2, 4] # Extract slope P-value

# Format the subtitle text dynamically
# If P is very small, use scientific notation
p_label <- ifelse(p_value < 2.2e-16, "P < 2.2e-16", sprintf("P = %.2e", p_value))
stats_subtitle <- sprintf("Spearman rho: %.3f | Slope %s", spearman_val, p_label)

# --- 3. Plot P1: Raw Comparison ---
p1 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = ESM.1v, y = log2_score)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = clinvar_group, color = clinvar_group, alpha = clinvar_group), size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = 17, "Benign" = 16, "Other" = 16)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "grey70", "Benign" = "#1B9E77", "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Other" = 0.5, "Benign" = 0.9, "Pathogenic" = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "CARD11 - Raw Scores",
    subtitle = sprintf("Correlation between ESM1v and SGE (rho = %.3f)", 
                       cor(plotting_data$ESM.1v, plotting_data$log2_score, method="spearman", use="complete.obs")),
    x = "Predicted Pathogenicity (ESM1v)",
    y = "Experimental Function (SGE)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") 

# --- 4. Plot P2: Residual Comparison (The Main Argument) ---
p2 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = Signal_Residual, y = Exp_Residual)) +
  # Add Quadrant Lines to highlight the "Allosteric Concordance" (Bottom-Left)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(aes(shape = clinvar_group, color = clinvar_group, alpha = clinvar_group), size = 2.5) +
  
  # Linear Regression Line (The "Significant Positive Slope")
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = 17, "Benign" = 16, "Other" = 16)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "grey70", "Benign" = "#1B9E77", "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Other" = 0.5, "Benign" = 0.9, "Pathogenic" = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Stability-independent Effects",
    subtitle = stats_subtitle, # Uses the calculated P-value < 2.2e-16
    x = "Predicted Residual (ESM1v - Stability)",
    y = "Experimental Residual (SGE - Stability)",
    shape = "ClinVar", color = "ClinVar"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# --- 5. Combine ---
final_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 1))
print(final_plot)

# Verify the P-value in console to confirm your text is correct
print(paste("Slope P-value:", p_value))
```
```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# 4. Create Categorical Data with the Split
class_data <- card11_df %>%
  drop_na(log2_score, ESM.1v, ddG_pred) %>%
  mutate(
    # Map distances back to dataframe
    min_dist = dist_vals[as.character(mutation_position)],
    
    # Define States
    Stability_State = ifelse(ddG_pred > 1, "Destabilized", "Stable"),
    ESM_State = ifelse(ESM.1v < -7.75, "Pred_Pathogenic", "Pred_Benign"),
    
    # Define Categories (Splitting the 'Stable-Pathogenic' group)
    Category = case_when(
      # 1. Destabilized (The classic mechanism)
      Stability_State == "Destabilized" ~ "Destabilized",
      
      # 2. Stable & Benign (True Negatives)
      Stability_State == "Stable" & ESM_State == "Pred_Benign" ~ "Stable-Benign",
      
      # 3. Stable & Pathogenic -> ORTHOSTERIC (Close to active site)
      Stability_State == "Stable" & ESM_State == "Pred_Pathogenic" ~ "Stable-Pathogenic",
      
      TRUE ~ "Undefined"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Category != "Undefined") %>%
  # Reorder factors for plot logic
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Stable-Benign", "Stable-Pathogenic", "Destabilized")))

# 5. Plot the Boxplot
# We want to show that "Allosteric" variants are functionally impaired (Low SGE), proving ESM is right.
# Ensure you have the library loaded
library(ggsignif)

# 1. Calculate Sample Sizes & Positions for Labels
# We calculate 'n' and pick a y-position slightly above the max value of each group
n_labels <- class_data %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    y_pos = max(log2_score, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5  # Adjust +0.5 to move text higher/lower
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n = ", n))

# 2. Plot with Labels
p_box_split <- ggplot(class_data, aes(x = Category, y = log2_score, fill = Category)) +
  # Reference line for SGE pathogenicity
  geom_hline(yintercept = -0.711, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") + 
  
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Destabilized" = "#D95F02",
    "Stable-Benign" = "#1B9E77",
    "Stable-Pathogenic" = "#7570B3"
  )) +
  
  # --- ADDED: Sample Size Labels ---
  geom_text(data = n_labels, 
            aes(x = Category, y = y_pos, label = label), 
            color = "black", 
            vjust = 0,    # Sit on top of the y_pos
            size = 4) +   # Text size
  # ---------------------------------

  # Significance Testing
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Stable-Benign", "Stable-Pathogenic")),
    map_signif_level = TRUE, 
    test = "wilcox.test",    
    step_increase = 0.1,
    textsize = 4,
    vjust = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "CARD11 (Meitlis et al., 2020)",
    subtitle = "Prediction vs SGE Data",
    y = "SGE Score",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

print(p_box_split)

# 6. Calculate Stats for the Text
stats <- class_data %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Median_SGE = median(log2_score),
    Percent_Confirmed_Pathogenic = mean(log2_score < -0.711) * 100
  )
print(stats)
```

```{r}
# 1. Filter for variants ESM1v *says* are Pathogenic (but are Stable)
predicted_pathogenic_stable <- class_data %>%
  filter(Category %in% c("Stable-Pathogenic"))

# 2. Count how many of these are NOT pathogenic in SGE (False Positives)
# We assume SGE < -1.5 is Pathogenic, so SGE >= -1.5 is Benign/WT-like
false_positives <- predicted_pathogenic_stable %>%
  filter(log2_score >= -0.711)

# 3. Calculate the Stats
n_predicted <- nrow(predicted_pathogenic_stable)
n_false_positives <- nrow(false_positives)
fdr_percentage <- (n_false_positives / n_predicted) * 100
accuracy_percentage <- 100 - fdr_percentage

# 4. Print the exact sentence for the reviewer
print(paste("Total Stable variants predicted Pathogenic:", n_predicted))
print(paste("Number confirmed Pathogenic by SGE:", n_predicted - n_false_positives))
print(paste("Number NOT Pathogenic (False Positives):", n_false_positives))
print(paste("False Discovery Rate (Over-prediction):", round(fdr_percentage, 1), "%"))
```
